# Optimal dosing and schedules of vaccines

*A draft investigation by Witold Więcek, June 2024.*

The purpose of this report is to serve as a general introduction to the optimal dosing and scheduling of vaccines. Its notes can be read in any order.

Start with the [executive summary](overview/index.qmd), or go directly to a topic:

- [Overview](overview/index.qmd): biology, vaccine development, implementation, population benefits and decision-making.
- [Vaccines](vaccines/index.qmd): short assessments of individual diseases and vaccines.
- [Case studies](case-studies/index.qmd): COVID, mpox, polio and yellow fever.
- [Research agenda](research-agenda/index.qmd): possible projects, knowledge gaps, future pathways and reservations.
- [About](about/index.qmd): the report's scope, background and acknowledgements.
